hypothesis: Artifact-scoped advisory semantic reviewers for selected non-builder workflows will surface queue-triage and source-decision issues without changing workflow pass/fail outcomes until measured evidence justifies blocking promotion.

metricsCompared.name: focused shadow-review behavior tests
metricsCompared.baseline: non-builder workflows had no typed advisory semantic-review protocol or artifact parser
metricsCompared.candidate: shadow review, workflow, and report CLI tests cover advisory artifacts, skipped targets, malformed reviewer output, hidden-context exclusion, and report rendering

metricsCompared.name: workflow rollout posture
metricsCompared.baseline: builder critic was the only mature semantic review path
metricsCompared.candidate: inbox-sorter and research-retry run advisory reviewer steps that write artifacts without changing commit success unless later promoted

metricsCompared.name: operator observability
metricsCompared.baseline: operator report had no shadow semantic reviewer section
metricsCompared.candidate: report aggregates catches, false-positive annotations, skipped target resolution, malformed/error artifacts, cost, duration, and run refs

rationale: The change starts as advisory-only evidence collection for two representative non-builder workflows. Review input is constrained to declared artifacts, blocking mode is explicitly gated by a future promoted autonomy-change decision, and focused validation covers the artifact parser, workflow target resolution, advisory non-blocking behavior, and report rendering.
